characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Start of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), the owner may remove the bearer’s unit from the Battlefield and redeploy it in a new formation following the usual restrictions.
Attached models remain Attached.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit gains Magic Resistance (1) and is always considered to be in Soft Cover.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The attack gains +1 to hit and always wounds on at least 4+ when allocated towards a Health Pool entirely with Height 4-5.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Aegis (6+), Dances of Cenyrn (see Blade Dancer unit), Exclusive (Blade Dancer Kindred, Blade Dancers), Fearless, and Magic Resistance (1).
In addition, the model’s unit gains Devastating Charge (Fly) and Swiftstride.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: Number of Shots is always 1, Str 3, AP 2, Area Attack (1×5) and Direct Hit (Str 6, AP 4, Multiple Wounds (2)).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The Strength, Armour Penetration, and additional Attack Attributes are defined in brackets (X).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops, and Skirmisher.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Afflict (−1 Dis), and enemy units in contact cannot claim Combat Score bonus from their Proper Ranks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Combat Choices, a unit entirely with Dances of Cenyrn must choose one of the following Dances, model parts with Elf gain its effects, with Duration: Round of Combat.
  • Dance of Bedevilments: Afflict (−1 Dis), and enemy units in contact cannot claim Combat Score bonus from their Proper Ranks.
  • Dance of Biting Wind: +1 AP and Lethal Strike
  • Dance of the Parting Mists: −1 Str, −1 AP, and Aegis (3+)
  • Dance of Whirling Blades: +1 Att The unit cannot choose a specific Dance again until after one or both of the following has happened:
  • The unit is not Engaged in Combat.
  • The unit has chosen a different Dance.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For Shooting Attacks allocated against a Health Pool with Elven Cloak a to-hit roll of '1', '2', or '3' is always considered a miss, instead of the usual '1'.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Impaling Roots (if it did not already have it).
In addition, the model gains the following model rule, with Duration: Round of Combat. During Combat Choices, select a single enemy Character model in contact with the wielder: Melee Attacks from the selected model must reroll successful to-hit rolls against the wielder.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If a unit entierly with Forest Dweller is within 3" of a Forest, it benefits from Stubborn. In addition, if the unit already contains Stubborn, the unit is considered Steady when rolling Break Tests.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Place a Forest* underneath the target until the last model in the unit is removed as a casualty. This Forest always extends up to the edges of the target’s Unit Boundary (even if the unit moves or changes formation). Whenever the target is within 3" of another Forest or an another unit entirely with Sylvan Spirit, it must reroll to-hit and to-wound rolls of ‘1’ with its Melee Attacks.
* You may place a marker next to the unit instead

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Vanguard.
Moreover, the model, as well as any Elf Rank-and-File model part in its unit, benefits from First Strike (Hatred).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
The attack’s AP is set to at least 3. This can only be used with a Sylvan Bow.
Note: the Standard Melee Attacks of a Pathfinder Character with Spirit of the Whirlwind and Paired Weapons have Armour Penetration 3 (Forest’s Thorns does not increase it to Armour Penetration 5).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the target is within 3" of a Forest, use the Strength and Armour Penetration values in brackets.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
Can be activated during the Charge Phase or during the Shooting Phase.
This is a Shooting Weapon with the following profile: [noitemsep,wide=0pt, leftmargin=+ 2]
  • Aim 2+, Range 30", Shots 3D6, Str 4, AP 1, Magical Attacks and Quick to Fire. Hail Shot cannot benefit from Forest’s Thorns.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Feigned Flight, Hit and Run, Light Troops, Vanguard, and the Heath Rider model part gains a Light Lance and a Sylvan Bow (3+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains a Shield and the Heath Rider model part gains a Lance.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s unit gains Magical Attacks and Strider.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated when a friendly unit within 8" fails a Charge Range roll: the Charge Range roll is rerolled.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Str and +1 AP.
If the wielder causes any HP loss with this weapon, the wielder and all Rank-and-File models in its unit gain Distracting (1), with Duration: Round of Combat

characteristics.$text:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Tree Singing, and Elven Cloak.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
One use only. May be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase if the bearer’s unit is Unengaged, consists entirely of Height 1 models, and is fully inside a Forest that is not in contact with any enemy model: apply the following rules: [noitemsep,wide=0pt, leftmargin=+ 2]
  • Remove the bearer’s unit from the Battlefield.
  • Immediately place it back using Ambush (centre of Forest). If the unit cannot be placed, it is removed as a casualty where it was removed.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Forest’s Thorns, Scout, Stand and Shoot, and Vanguard.
A Sylvan Bow wielded by the model has its number of Shots set to 3 if the wielder is a Chieftain with Captain, to 5 otherwise.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Poison Attacks, Quick to Fire, Stand and Shoot

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: Permanent.
May be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase, if the bearer is Unengaged: place a Forest, in contact with the bearer and at least 1" away from enemy units and other Terrain Features.
This Forest has the dimensions of a 10"×6" rectangle. It follows the normal Forest rules, except it is Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Every model part with Sylvan Spirit in the model’s unit benefit from First Strike (Hatred).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains +2" Cha and +2" Mob, as well as Devastating Charge (Height is set to 3), Solitary, and Vanguard.
The model part gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 4-5).

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 HP, Aegis (5+), Fearless, Tree Singing, and Weakness (Flaming Attacks).
The Armour value is set to 4 and can never be improved beyond this.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
May be activated when the bearer’s unit Declares a Charge: the target of the Charge can only declare Hold! as its Charge Reaction, unless it is Shaken.
The enemy unit may still declare Charge Reactions as normal if charged by other units.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
When attacking with this weapon, before rolling to hit, choose one model with Channel in the target unit.
The chosen model replaces its rule Channel (X) with Channel (X–1). Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The sum of the Sylvan Beasts values stated in brackets of all models in the army is restricted to 1 per 1500 Army Points (rounding fractions up).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Pre-game Selections, you may place a single Forest on the Battlefield, so that it is not inside either Deployment Zone and not in contact with any other Terrain Feature. This Forest has the dimensions of a 10"×6" rectangle. In addition to the normal Forest rules, it is Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain, and can never be chosen for Primary or Secondary Objectives.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Every Standard Melee Attack performed by a model part with Sylvan Spirit, in a unit containing Toxic Spores benefits from Lethal Strike.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Once in your Magic Phase, immediately after Excess Magic, a single model with Tree Singing can move a Forest following the steps below. The owner may discard a Magic Dice to increase the range to the distances written in square brackets [X"].
  • Choose a Forest not in contact with any unit and within 8" [24"] of a friendly model with Tree Singing.
  • Move this Forest in a straight line up to 4" [12"], or until just before moving into contact with any unit or Terrain Feature.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model Recovers 1 HP the first time each Magic Phase that it successfully casts a Learned Spell targetting a friendly unit.
It cannot Recover more than 1 HP in total per Magic Phase from this spell or Fountain of Youth (Druidism).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Fearless, Frenzy, Light Troops, and Unruly.
In addition, the model part gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att), Fury, and Lethal Strike.
